info.name: Chariot FDX Accounts Donor Advised Funds API

params.name: supportedOnly
params.description: If set to true, filters DAFs to only those that have a direct integration with Chariot.

params.name: query
params.description: If included, filters DAFs to only those that contain the query. This parameter is case insensitive.

params.name: pageLimit
params.description: the number of results to return; defaults to 10, max is 100

params.name: pageToken
params.description: A token to use to retrieve the next page of results. This is useful for paginating over many pages of results. If set, all other arguments are expected to be kept the same as previous calls.

items.docs:
Returns a list of all Donor Advised Funds within Chariot's system. This API allows for paginating over many results.

<Note>
If there are DAFs missing from the list, please contact support at support@givechariot.com.
</Note>

params.name: id
params.description:
The unique id of the DAF.
The format should be a v4 UUID according to RFC 4122.

items.docs: Retrieve a DAF with a given ID.
